sub_problems.fills: `cairn artifact reland <root> --why` re-lands every journal entry the door parked when git replaced the journal under its append: each is appended once, chained on the journal's tail, keeping its writer's caller and why, and only when the record still stands at the bytes the entry describes; anything else stays parked and is named.
sub_problems.what: D1: artifact.py gains reland(name, *, why) -> {'relanded': [new entry ids], 'dropped': [parked ids already landed], 'kept': [{'entry', 'path', 'reason'}]}, beside orphan_park. Under door_lock(root): read the park (absent -> nothing to do), read_journal; for each parked entry in park order: if its id equals some journal entry's entry or relanded_from -> dropped; elif last_sha(journal, path) == sha_before and _sha(standing bytes or None) == sha_after -> copy less prev/entry, plus relanded_from (its id), relanded_why (why), relanded_by (caller()), through _append, and the journal list grows by it; else kept with the reason naming both shas. A JournalLineOrphaned from _append keeps that entry and the rest. The park is rewritten (temp + os.replace, or removed when empty) to the kept entries plus every park line beyond the ones read. A blank why is refused. The docstring names this ticket.
sub_problems.why: Since 0f8aefbba1d0 the door parks a line git replaced under it, in <git dir>/cairn-orphaned-lines.jsonl, and names the re-land as a later act. Measured 2026-11-13: f695fac922cd's lost PROVEME line could only be repaired by a scratch script calling artifact._entry/_append by hand (restore_f695_entry.py); until a verb exists, every parked line is a commit blocked with 'changed around the door' or a repair written around the door.

sub_problems.what: D3: the proof builds the scratch-git commons world of test_a_journal_line_survives_a_git_rewrite.py and parks a real entry by its shape (b) (a stash mid-append, then the pop). Tooth 1: reland appends it once, chained, verify_chain [], check_staged [] after staging the record, park empty, the line keeping the original why and caller and naming relanded_from. Tooth 2: (a) the record written again through the door before reland, (b) the record overwritten around the door: each keeps the entry parked, named, the journal unchanged, and the CLI exits 1. Tooth 3: reland twice — the second appends nothing; a park whose entry already stands is emptied without appending. Red on a73b82545 (no reland). PROVES names clauses 1-3; sealed in the same commit.
